title: Count Square Sum Triples
description: A square triple (a, b, c) is a triple where a, b, and c are integers and a^2 + b^2 = c^2. Given an integer n, return the number of square triples such that 1 <= a, b, c <= n.

title: Minimum String Length After Removing Substrings
description: You are given a string s consisting only of uppercase English letters. You can repeatedly remove any occurrence of substrings "AB" or "CD". Return the minimum possible length of the resulting string.
constraints: s consists only of uppercase English letters.

title: Furthest Point From Origin
description: You are given a string moves of length n consisting of characters 'L', 'R', and '_'. Return the distance from the origin you can reach after making n moves optimally choosing '_' as 'L' or 'R'.
constraints: moves consists only of characters 'L', 'R' and '_'.

title: The Latest Login in 2020
description: Write a solution to report the latest login for all users in the year 2020. Do not include the users who did not login in 2020.
constraints: (user_id, time_stamp) is the primary key of Logins table.

title: Hamming Distance
description: The Hamming distance between two integers is the number of positions at which the corresponding bits are different. Given two integers x and y, return the Hamming distance between them.

title: N-ary Tree Preorder Traversal
description: Given the root of an n-ary tree, return the preorder traversal of its nodes' values.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 10^4].
The height of the n-ary tree is less than or equal to 1000.

title: Divide a String Into Groups of Size k
description: A string s can be partitioned into groups of size k. If the final group is shorter, pad it using character fill. Return a string array containing all groups.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
fill is a lowercase English letter.

title: Sum of Root To Leaf Binary Numbers
description: You are given the root of a binary tree where each node has a value 0 or 1. Return the sum of numbers formed by all root-to-leaf paths in binary representation.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 1000].

title: Find the Key of the Numbers
description: You are given three positive integers num1, num2, and num3. Pad them with leading zeros to 4 digits, and find the key generated by taking the minimum digit at each position.

title: Construct Uniform Parity Array I
description: You are given an array nums1 of n distinct integers. Construct an array nums2 such that all elements are either all odd or all even by choosing nums2[i] = nums1[i] or nums2[i] = nums1[i] - nums1[j]. Return true if possible.

title: Game Play Analysis I
description: Write a solution to find the first login date for each player.

examples.input: Activity table with player_id, device_id, event_date, games_played

constraints: (player_id, event_date) is the primary key of Activity table.

title: Projection Area of 3D Shapes
description: You are given an n x n grid where grid[i][j] represents the tower height of placed 1x1x1 cubes. Return the total area of all three projections (xy, yz, and zx planes).

title: Reformat Department Table
description: Reformat the Department table such that there is a department id column and revenue columns for each of the 12 months.

examples.input: Department table with id, revenue, month
examples.output: Reformatted table with id, Jan_Revenue, Feb_Revenue, ..., Dec_Revenue

constraints: (id, month) is the primary key of Department table.

title: Uncommon Words from Two Sentences
description: A sentence is a string of single-space separated words. A word is uncommon if it appears exactly once in one of the sentences, and does not appear in the other sentence. Return a list of all uncommon words.

examples.input: s1 = "this apple is sweet", s2 = "this apple is sour"

constraints: s1 and s2 consist of lowercase English letters and spaces.

title: Find Lucky Integer in an Array
description: Given an array of integers arr, a lucky integer is an integer that has a frequency in the array equal to its value. Return the largest lucky integer in the array, or -1 if none exists.

title: Maximum Difference by Remapping a Digit
description: You are given an integer num. Remap one digit from 0-9 to another digit to create the maximum possible and minimum possible values. Return the difference between them.

title: Maximum Difference Between Adjacent Elements in a Circular Array
description: Given a circular integer array nums, find the maximum absolute difference between adjacent elements in the array.

title: Take Gifts From the Richest Pile
description: You are given an integer array gifts and an integer k. In each second, choose the pile with the maximum gifts and leave behind floor(sqrt(gifts[i])). Return the total remaining gifts after k seconds.

title: Calculate Delayed Arrival Time
description: You are given two positive integers arrivalTime and delayedTime. Return the time when the train will arrive at the station in 24-hour format.

title: Maximum Containers on a Ship
description: You are given an n x n cargo deck on a ship where each cell holds a container of weight w. Given maxWeight capacity, return the maximum number of containers that can be loaded.

title: Find the Peaks
description: You are given a 0-indexed array mountain. Return an array that consists of all the peak indices in the mountain array.

title: Relative Sort Array
description: Given two arrays arr1 and arr2, the elements of arr2 are distinct, and all elements in arr2 are in arr1. Sort the elements of arr1 such that the relative ordering of items matches arr2, with non-matching elements sorted ascending at the end.
constraints: All the elements of arr2 are distinct.

title: Average of Levels in Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the average value of the nodes on each level in the form of an array.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10^4].

title: Maximum Units on a Truck
description: You are assigned to put some amount of boxes on one truck. Given 2D array boxTypes and truckSize, return the maximum total number of units that can be put on the truck.

title: Keep Multiplying Found Values by Two
description: You are given an array of integers nums and an integer original. Repeatedly multiply original by 2 as long as original is found in nums. Return the final value of original.

title: Find Common Characters
description: Given a string array words, return an array of all characters that show up in all strings within the words (including duplicates).
constraints: words[i] consists of lowercase English letters.

title: Primary Department for Each Employee
description: Write a solution to report all the employees with their primary department. For employees with only one department, report that department.

examples.input: Employee table with employee_id, department_id, primary_flag

constraints: (employee_id, department_id) is the primary key of Employee table.

title: Sum of Digits of String After Convert
description: You are given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, and an integer k. Convert s into an integer by replacing each letter with its position in the alphabet, and transform it by summing its digits k times.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.

title: Count Largest Group
description: Given an integer n, group integers from 1 to n according to the sum of their digits. Return the number of groups that have the largest size.

title: Apply Operations to an Array
description: Given an array nums, if nums[i] == nums[i + 1], multiply nums[i] by 2 and set nums[i + 1] to 0. After applying all operations, shift all 0's to the end while maintaining the order of non-zero elements.

title: Largest Positive Integer That Exists With Its Negative
description: Given an integer array nums that does not contain any zeros, find the largest positive integer k such that -k also exists in the array. Return -1 if no such integer exists.

title: The K Weakest Rows in a Matrix
description: You are given an m x n binary matrix mat of 1's (soldiers) and 0's (civilians). Return the indices of the k weakest rows in the matrix ordered from weakest to strongest.

title: Maximum Value of a String in an Array
description: The value of an alphanumeric string can be defined as its numeric base-10 value if it consists of digits only, or its length otherwise. Given an array strs, return the maximum value of any string.
constraints: strs[i] consists of only lowercase English letters and digits.

title: Matrix Similarity After Cyclic Shifts
description: You are given an m x n integer matrix mat and an integer k. Even rows are shifted to the left by k and odd rows to the right by k. Return true if the final matrix is identical to the initial matrix.

title: Binary Gap
description: Given a positive integer n, find and return the longest distance between any two adjacent 1's in the binary representation of n. If there are no two adjacent 1's, return 0.

title: Maximum Count of Positive Integer and Negative Integer
description: Given an array nums sorted in non-decreasing order, return the maximum between the number of positive integers and the number of negative integers.
constraints: nums is sorted in a non-decreasing order.

title: Row With Maximum Ones
description: Given an m x n binary matrix mat, find the 0-indexed row index that has the maximum count of ones, and the count of ones in that row. Return [rowIndex, count].

title: Keyboard Row
description: Given an array of strings words, return the words that can be typed using letters of the alphabet on only one row of American keyboard.
constraints: words[i] consists of English letters (both lowercase and uppercase).

title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
description: A fancy string is a string where no three consecutive characters are equal. Given a string s, delete the minimum possible number of characters from s to make it fancy.
constraints: s consists only of lowercase English letters.

title: Smallest Range I
description: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. For each element nums[i], choose an integer x with -k <= x <= k and add it to nums[i]. Return the minimum score of the modified array.

title: Split With Minimum Sum
description: Given a positive integer num, split all its digits into two non-negative integers num1 and num2 such that each digit appears exactly once and num1 + num2 is minimized.

title: Longest Subsequence With Limited Sum
description: You are given an integer array nums of length n, and an integer array queries of length m. Return an array answer where answer[i] is the maximum size of a subsequence that you can take from nums such that the sum of its elements is <= queries[i].

title: Number of Even and Odd Bits
description: You are given a positive integer n. Let even denote the number of even indices in the binary representation of n with value 1, and odd denote odd indices with value 1. Return [even, odd].

title: Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements I
description: You are given an integer array nums. Find the minimum distance of a good tuple (i, j, k) where nums[i] == nums[j] == nums[k], defined as abs(i - j) + abs(j - k) + abs(k - i). Return -1 if no such tuple exists.

title: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
description: A vowel substring is a substring that only consists of vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', and 'u') and has all five vowels present in it. Given a string word, return the number of vowel substrings in word.
constraints: word consists of lowercase English letters only.

title: Univalued Binary Tree
description: A binary tree is uni-valued if every node in the tree has the same value. Given the root of a binary tree, return true if the given tree is uni-valued, or false otherwise.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 100].

title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Values Equal to K
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the minimum number of valid reduction operations required to make all elements equal to k, or -1 if impossible.

title: Minimum Deletions for At Most K Distinct Characters
description: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters and an integer k, return the minimum number of deletions required so that s contains at most k distinct characters.
constraints: s consists only of lowercase English letters.

title: Earliest Finish Time for Land and Water Rides I
description: Given schedule details for land rides and water rides, find the earliest finish time to experience one land ride and one water ride in any order.

title: Shortest Distance to a Character
description: Given a string s and a character c that occurs in s, return an array of integers answer where answer[i] is the shortest distance from the index i to the character c in s.
constraints: s[i] and c are lowercase English letters.
It is guaranteed that c occurs at least once in s.

title: Time Needed to Buy Tickets
description: There are n people in a line queuing to buy tickets. Each person takes 1 second to buy 1 ticket and goes to the back. Return the time taken for the person at position k to finish buying tickets.

title: Number of Lines To Write String
description: You are given a string s of lowercase English letters and an array widths denoting the pixel width of each letter. Return an array [totalLines, lastLineWidth] after wrapping at 100 pixels per line.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters.

title: Largest 3-Same-Digit Number in String
description: You are given a string num representing a large integer. An integer is good if it is a substring of num of length 3 consisting of only one unique digit. Return the maximum good integer as a string, or "" if none exists.

title: Fill Missing Data
description: Write a solution to fill in the missing values in the quantity column with 0 in the products DataFrame.

examples.input: products DataFrame with name, quantity, price
examples.output: DataFrame with missing quantity replaced with 0

title: Replace Elements with Greatest Element on Right Side
description: Given an array arr, replace every element in that array with the greatest element among the elements to its right, and replace the last element with -1.

title: Find the Original Typed String I
description: Alice is attempting to type a string word. Occasionally, she holds down a key too long, resulting in repeated characters. Return the total number of possible original strings Alice could have intended.
constraints: word consists only of lowercase English letters.

title: Find the Distance Value Between Two Arrays
description: Given two integer arrays arr1 and arr2, and an integer d, return the distance value between the two arrays (the number of elements arr1[i] such that there is no element arr2[j] with |arr1[i] - arr2[j]| <= d).

title: Available Captures for Rook
description: On an 8 x 8 chessboard with one white rook 'R', empty squares '.', white bishops 'B', and black pawns 'p', return the number of available pawns the rook can capture in one move.
constraints: There is exactly one rook on the board.

title: Find Words That Can Be Formed by Characters
description: You are given an array of strings words and a string chars. A string is good if it can be formed by characters from chars. Return the sum of lengths of all good strings in words.
constraints: words[i] and chars consist of lowercase English letters.

title: Two Furthest Houses With Different Colors
description: There are n houses evenly lined up on the street, each house colored differently. Given an integer array colors, return the maximum distance between two houses with different colors.
constraints: At least two houses have different colors.

title: Biggest Single Number
description: Find the largest single number in the MyNumbers table. If there is no single number, report null.
constraints: MyNumbers table may contain duplicate records.

title: Distribute Candies
description: Alice has n candies where the ith candy is of type candyType[i]. Alice can eat at most n / 2 candies. Return the maximum number of different types of candies she can eat.

title: Sort Array By Parity II
description: Given an array of integers nums of length 2n with half even and half odd, sort the array so that whenever nums[i] is odd, i is odd, and whenever nums[i] is even, i is even.
constraints: Half of the integers in nums are even.

title: Actors and Directors Who Cooperated At Least Three Times
description: Write a solution to find all the pairs (actor_id, director_id) where the actor has cooperated with the director at least three times.

examples.input: ActorDirector table with actor_id, director_id, timestamp

constraints: timestamp is the primary key of ActorDirector table.

title: Minimum Number of Operations to Make Elements in Array Distinct
description: Given an integer array nums, in one operation remove 3 elements from the beginning. Return the minimum number of operations needed to make all elements in nums distinct.

title: Transformed Array
description: Given a circular integer array nums, create a new array result where for each index i, you move nums[i] steps right if nums[i] > 0, abs(nums[i]) steps left if nums[i] < 0, or stay if 0.

title: Number Complement
description: The complement of an integer is the integer you get when you flip all the 0's to 1's and all the 1's to 0's in its binary representation. Given an integer num, return its complement.

title: Count Binary Substrings
description: Given a binary string s, return the number of non-empty substrings that have the same number of 0's and 1's, and all the 0's and all the 1's in these substrings are grouped consecutively.

title: Leaf-Similar Trees
description: Consider all the leaves of a binary tree, from left to right order, the values of those leaves form a leaf value sequence. Return true if and only if the two given trees are leaf-similar.
constraints: The number of nodes in each tree will be in the range [1, 200].
